notes.title: Looking Ahead to 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41167387/14678f13629b2fc5178d6c32574cccb317b8ed9c.png[/img]

[h3]Happy 2023, everyone![/h3]
We at Box of Mushrooms are so grateful for the community we’ve built over the past year. From all of you who have followed and wishlisted since our store page went up, to those we met on our other platforms (IG, Twitch, Twitter, etc.), it’s been humbling to see so many of you excited for what we plan to bring with Gazelle in a Winter Coat. Speaking of…

[h3]Demo Coming Soon![/h3]
This year, we plan to release our very first playable demo of Gazelle! Since our last live-streamed showcase, we’ve spent a lot of time writing and designing all sorts of aspects of the game. With our demo, we hope to give you a small piece of what we’ve come up with in that time. You can expect the demo to be out early 2023!

[h3]But That’s Not All…[/h3]
Here are a few other things we’re looking forward to this year:

[list]
[*] Our first teaser and trailer will be coming out! See Rene and co. in action as we preview what’s to come in the full game.
[*] [b]Playtesting![/b] As production picks up, we’ll be reaching out to playtesters on new mechanics and levels that we’ve been working on.
[*] [b]Behind the scenes![/b] We’ll be showing more and more of our art and design work on the usual social media platforms, so be sure to check them out!
[*] [b]Festivals![/b] We’re pushing to get Gazelle in a Winter Coat in a 2023 festival, and it will be GLORIOUS
[*] [b]Merch![/b] Perhaps even a real-life winter coat? (idk maybe not lol)
[/list]
Stay tuned for updates on all of these, and then some!

~The Box of Mushrooms team
